name: Bloom
tagline: Art, a launch film and a logo for your idea
rationale: A lowercase b whose bowl is one petal, so the initial and the name say the same thing. Heavy, tight lowercase Geist matches the software tools it sits beside, and one loud pink keeps it out of the blue and black field.

colors.idea: Bloom Pink #FF3D9A: warm and loud in a field of blue and black dev tools.

symbol.idea: A b drawn as a stem and a single petal.

wordmark.idea: Geist at 800, tight, the type of the tools it works with.

alternatives.label: Option 2: Five dots
alternatives.why: A flower built from five dots with a seed cut out, a nod to the dot art the skills draw.
